title_zh: 帮助计划的网站或应用

cue_card.prompt: Describe a website or app that helps you organise your life.
bullets: what the website or app does
explain how it has changed your habits

part3.question: Are people becoming too dependent on devices to remember things?
Do you think employers should monitor how long staff spend on productivity apps?
Why do some people still prefer paper diaries to digital calendars?

fallback_questions: Would you trust an app to make important decisions for you?
How can design stop people from spending too much time on a single app?
Should there be limits on how much personal data an app can collect?
